subject.title: feat: add i18n support for dreaming journal

question: Should memory-core dreaming accept a user-facing locale config for journal/report labels now, or should this wait for a different localization/template contract?
rationale: The PR adds new plugin config and localization policy surface; repository policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces, and the current branch is only a partial no-op foundation.

options.title: Require complete locale config
options.body: Accept `dreaming.language` only as a maintainer-approved bounded locale contract and require the PR to wire it through all writers with docs, tests, and real proof before merge.

options.title: Request a template design
options.body: Pause this branch and ask for a custom-template or broader localization design instead of a fixed language registry.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Keep dreaming structural labels in English until maintainers choose a broader product localization strategy.

recommendation.title: Require complete locale config
recommendation.body: Accept `dreaming.language` only as a maintainer-approved bounded locale contract and require the PR to wire it through all writers with docs, tests, and real proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` has recent memory-core dreaming history and is a reasonable owner for deciding whether this config surface fits the feature direction.
